fields.climate: in the north, continental climate (cold winters and hot, humid summers with well-distributed rainfall)…
fields.terrain: extremely varied; to the north, rich fertile plains; to the east, limestone ranges and basins; to the southeast, ancient mountains and hills
fields.resources: oil, gas, coal, iron ore, copper, zinc, antimony, chromite, gold, silver, magnesium, pyrite, limestone, marble, salt, arable land
fields.farm: maize, wheat, sugar beets, milk, sunflower seeds, soybeans, potatoes, barley, apples, plums
fields.exports: insulated wire, electricity, copper ore, plastic products, electric motors
fields.industries: automobiles, base metals, furniture, food processing, machinery, chemicals, sugar, tires, clothes, pharmaceuticals
fields.languages: Serbian (official) 88.1%, Hungarian 3.4%, Bosnian 1.9%, Romani 1.4%, other 3.4%, undeclared or unknown 1.8%
fields.religions: Serbian Orthodox 81.1%, unknown 5.3%, Islam 4.2%, Catholic 3.9%, no response 2.5%, atheist 1.1%; less than 1%: other Christians, Protestant, agnostic

independence.from: State Union of Serbia and Montenegro

fields.suffrage: 18 years of age, 16 if employed; universal

holiday.name: Statehood Day, 15 February
holiday.date: the day the first constitution of the country was adopted

fields.military: 18 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; conscription abolished in 2011
